development: GSE107958 cerebellum, 17.5 months; multiregion EB already explored
GSE145613 cerebellum, 12 months; expression QC previously explored
external: GSE261670 cerebellum, 65 weeks, no treatment attribute
selection_rule: Exactly 6 WT and 6 Q84, one tissue and age only. Never use treated samples. Sample labels and metadata checked before expression; repeated tissues never counted as independent animals.
study_independence: Distinct publications/laboratories, model/age designs, and nonoverlapping GEO samples versus development. Unique animal IDs across laboratories unavailable; no claim of independently audited lineage records.
biological_estimand: Cross-model/age transport of a fixed SCA3-associated cerebellar expression signature, not identical effect sizes or clinical replication
nomination_rule: Intersect unambiguous gene-symbol mappings from Ensembl release91 with GSE107958. Rank single_study_z by absolute Welch t; multiregion_EB by absolute posterior mean / SD; consensus by minimum absolute t only when all signs agree. Stable lexicographic tie break. No use of external expression in nomination.
external_annotation: Ensembl 108 GRCm39 transcript-to-gene annotation, matching source metadata. Require >=99% transcript IDs matched; stop on incompatible annotation. Stable IDs strip versions; ambiguous gene symbols excluded.
external_expression: Sum transcript TPM per gene, log2(gene TPM+0.5). Not a count likelihood and not FASTQ reprocessing.
primary_test: For each frozen signature, average direction-weighted per-gene standardized expression. Standardization is label-invariant across all external samples. Enumerate all choose(12,6)=924 assignments. One-sided exact permutation p, including observed assignment; Holm over four signature strategies.
secondary: Signed gene-level exact permutation mean-contrast p-values, BY across the union of nominated signed hypotheses; two signs of the same gene remain distinct. Bootstrap 2000 times within genotype for descriptive signature-score effect intervals; leave-one-animal influence. No binomial test treating genes as independent.
holdout_rule: Freeze nominations plus method/protocol/input digests before external expression access; execution refuses changed frozen inputs or code. Do not tune using held results. Failed transport is retained.
prior_knowledge: Published SCA3 oligodendrocyte/myelin findings are already known; this is not a blinded discovery of a new disease mechanism.
scope: Independent public-cohort transport evaluation of the analysis workflow. Does NOT validate Gaussian CE-maxT assumptions, establish causal biology, or predict individual patients. Manuscript drafting awaits user.
